name: Create a sparse media-text case study pattern
query: Create a full-width case study teaser pattern with a large architectural image on the left and sparse centered copy on the right: title plus one text link.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and confirm target theme/plugin, image asset, title, slug, category, and text domain
Step 2: Use Media & Text or equivalent block-native layout aligned full
Step 3: Let the image carry most of the visual weight and keep the content side intentionally quiet
Step 4: Use a concise heading and an action-specific case-study link
Step 5: Provide descriptive alt text for the image if informational
Step 6: Escape and internationalize all visible strings and attributes
Step 7: Verify mobile stacking, image cropping, and block parsing
success_criteria: Uses Media & Text or a block-native two-column layout without custom CSS classes
Image and text have intentionally asymmetric visual weight
Includes a concise heading and descriptive link label
Image alt text is descriptive unless the image is clearly decorative
Uses theme presets or block attributes for spacing and color
No scripts, inline style tags, or raw untranslated PHP strings
